subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula is located just above the small waterfall near the log bridge in Gerudo Valley at night and its token can be retrieved with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Look just above the small waterfall to find a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gerudo Valley River
text: Diving into the river from the drawbridge west of the log bridge carries Link downstream to Lake Hylia, which connects back to Zora's Domain via an underwater passage.

evidence.quote: Head out to the drawbridge west of the log bridge and dive into the river.  Ride it down stream back to Lake Hylia and use the underwater passage to return to Zora's Domain.

subject: Zora's Domain Entrance Path
text: Climbing to the path leading to the front entrance allows Link to return to Zora's River and ride it downstream to Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote: Climb up to the path that leads to the front entrance, return to Zora's River, and ride it downstream back to Hyrule Field.

subject: Lone Tree Secret Pit
text: Placing a bomb on the north side of the lone tree in the northeast corner of Hyrule Field reveals a hidden pit.

evidence.quote: Before you enter the Village, go north from the stairs to find a lone tree in the very northeast corner of the field.  Place a bomb on the north side of the tree to blast open a pit.  Drop down.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula rests on webbing high on the wall at the end of the secret pit near Kakariko Village and can be killed to collect its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Run to the end of the pit and kill the Big Skulltula.  Look high on the wall, where a Gold Skulltula rests on a bit of webbing.  Kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token with your Boomerang.

subject: Giant's Wallet
text: Speaking with the man in the rear of the House of Skulltula after defeating 30 Gold Skulltulas rewards Link with the Giant's Wallet, which holds up to 500 rupees.

evidence.quote: Speak with the man in the rear of the room, and he'll award you for killing 30 Gold Skulltulas with the Giant's Wallet.  This is the largest wallet in the game, which can hold up to 500 rupees.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula appears high on the wall at the far south end of the second row of gravestones in the southeast corner of Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Head for the southeast corner of the graveyard, to the far south end of the second row of gravestones.  Look high on the wall to see another Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Magic Bean Soft Earth Patch
text: A soft patch of earth where a Magic Bean can be planted is located in the northwest corner of Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Now, head for the northwest corner of the graveyard where there is a soft patch of earth.  Plant one of your Magic Beans there.

subject: Kakariko Windmill Door
text: From the graveyard stairs in Kakariko Village, taking a right leads up a long staircase to the entrance of the Windmill behind a crate.

evidence.quote: From Kakariko Graveyard, take a right up the long staircase.  Enter the door on the right at the top of the stairs, behind the crate to enter the Windmill.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Piece of Heart sits high on a ledge to the left upon entering the Kakariko Windmill and can be grabbed using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Look to the left as you enter to see a Piece of Heart high on a ledge.  Get closer to it and use the Boomerang to snag it.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern Soft Earth Patch
text: A soft patch of earth suitable for planting a Magic Bean is located outside the mouth of Dodongo's Cavern on Death Mountain Trail.

evidence.quote: Start heading up the trail and enter the mouth of Dodongo's Cavern.  Plant one of your Magic Beans in the soft patch of earth, then enter the Cavern.

subject: Antechamber Moving Platform
text: Riding the moving platform on the right in front of the giant Dodongo's head takes Link to the second floor tunnel opposite the plaque.

evidence.quote: Head into the main chamber, out to in front of the giant Dodongo's head.  Board the moving platform on the right and ride it to the top.  Get off on the second floor, and enter the tunnel opposite the plaque.

subject: Blade Trap Room Tunnel
text: Dropping to the bottom level of the Blade Trap Room and climbing the southwest ladder leads through a tunnel back to the Antechamber.

evidence.quote: Jump off the cliff to the right as you enter the room to drop down to the bottom level.  Dodge the blade trap and climb the ladder near the southwest corner of the room.  Go through the tunnel back to the Antechamber.

subject: Antechamber Wooden Bridge
text: Crossing the wooden bridge on the second floor of the Antechamber leads to the door on the opposite side while avoiding Fire Keese.

evidence.quote: Cross the wooden bridge and enter the door on the opposite side.  Kill any Fire Keese who bother you.

subject: Pillar Room Switch
text: Pulling the Armos Statue away from the ladder on the south side of the Pillar Room allows Link to climb up and step on the pillar switch to unlock the doors.

evidence.quote: Kill the Fire Keese, then pull aside the Armos Statue blocking the ladder on the south side of the room.  Step on the switch on top of the pillar to unlock the doors, then leave through the north door.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: In the Bomb Flower Room, climbing the ivy walls to the iron platform allows Link to reach an alcove on the north side and retrieve a Gold Skulltula token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Climb up the ivy walls to the top of the iron platform.  Look into the alcove on the north side of the room, and use the Boomerang to kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula is perched on the second story window of the left building by the entrance arch of Lon Lon Ranch at night.

evidence.quote: Head towards the arch leading into the field, and stop to look at the second story window on the left building.  Kill the Gold Skulltula on the window, and take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the southwest wall to the right of the mill.

evidence.quote: Head out into the field, towards the southwest wall, to the right of the mill.  Kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's token with the Boomerang, then return to Hyrule Field.

subject: Running Man
text: Speaking to the Running Man in Hyrule Field while wearing the Bunny Hood after he pauses running rewards Link with 500 rupees.

evidence.quote: Once he has stopped, speak to him while wearing the Bunny Hood, and he will give you 500 rupees for it.

subject: Zelda's Escape
text: Approaching the closed gates of Hyrule Castle triggers a cutscene where Zelda and Impa flee and Zelda throws the Ocarina of Time into the moat.

evidence.quote: When you get close enough, a cut scene will take place.  Zelda and Impa will race out of the gates, and Zelda will do a really fantastic John Elway impression by throwing you the Ocarina of Time, which will land in the moat.

subject: Ocarina of Time
text: Diving into the moat water outside Hyrule Castle recovers the Ocarina of Time, triggering a telepathic message from Zelda teaching the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: After the cutscene is over, dive into the water of the moat to get the Ocarina of Time, at which point Zelda will contact you telepathically and teach you the Song of Time.

subject: Zora's Domain Waterfall Pool
text: Swimming to the bottom of the deep pool to the right of the waterfall at the entrance to Zora's Domain leads to a warp tunnel connecting to the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Once you reach the entrance to Zora's Domain, look to the right of the waterfall, where there is a deep pool of water.  Swim to it's bottom, and enter the tunnel at the bottom to warp to Lost Woods.

subject: Lost Woods Soft Earth Patch
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the soft earth patch past the Business Scrub reveals a Gold Skulltula, and a Magic Bean can be planted in the soil.

evidence.quote: Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth to reveal a Gold Skulltula (if you didn't get it last time you were here), and remember to recapture one of the three bugs that appears.  Plant one of the Magic Beans, then head for the large tree in the back of the clearing.

subject: Forest Stage Invisible Hole
text: Dropping into the hidden hole marked by hovering butterflies near the large tree leads to the Forest Stage.

evidence.quote: In the grass, there is a cluster of butterflies.  The butterflies are actually hovering over an invisible hole.  Drop down into this hole to enter the Forest Stage.

subject: Lost Woods Path
text: From the Forest Stage exit, heading through the log tunnel, right at the crossroads, right at the pool, left at the stone arch, right at the crossroads, and straight leads to the southwest tunnel.

evidence.quote: Run forward through the log tunnel, and go right at the crossroads on the other side.  Go right again at the pool of water, and left at the stone arch.  Turn right again at the next crossroads, and go straight at the next.  Enter the tunnel in the southwest corner of the next area.

subject: Lost Woods Clearing Soft Earth Patch
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the soft patch of earth in the southwest clearing uncovers a Gold Skulltula and allows planting a Magic Bean.

evidence.quote: Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth to get the Gold Skulltula (if you didn't get it last time), and remember to recapture one of the bugs who comes out.  Plant one of your Magic Beans in the patch.

subject: Deku Stick Upgrade
text: A Deku Stick upgrade can be bought from the Business Scrub located in the rear of the valley.

evidence.quote: If you still haven't bought the Deku Stick Upgrade from the Business Scrub in the rear of this valley, then do so now.

subject: Lost Woods Tunnel Path
text: Turning around and passing back through the log tunnel, hanging right through the following log tunnel, and taking a right leads into Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Turn around, and go back through the log tunnel.  Hang a right and go through the next log tunnel, then go to the right to enter Kokiri Forest.

subject: Mask of Truth
text: Paying the mask trader fifty rupees for the Bunny Hood completes the Happy Mask Trading sequence, unlocking the Mask of Truth which allows Link to read Gossip Stones.

evidence.quote: Speak with the mask trader, and pay him fifty rupees for the Bunny Hood.  You have now finished the entire Happy Mask Trading sequence, and can borrow any Mask that you want from the store.  For now, take the Mask of Truth, which lets you get hints from the Gossip Stones around the world, and also gets you a Deku Nut upgrade.

subject: Musical Frogs
text: Playing the Song of Time for the Musical Frogs at Zora's River awards Link fifty rupees.

evidence.quote: On the way, stop off at the Musical Frogs and play them the Song of Time to make back fifty rupees.

subject: Deku Nuts Upgrade
text: Wearing the Mask of Truth and speaking to the Deku Scrub Chief in the Forest Stage increases the number of Deku Nuts Link can carry.

evidence.quote: Put on the Mask of Truth, then step forward.  The Deku Scrubs down here will stare at you.  Go and speak to their Chief (the Scrub with the "mustache") on the right side of the  room, and he will increase the number of Deku Nuts you can carry.
